subject.title: fix(mcp): standalone apps stop hanging on stalled gateway requests

question: Should a shared MCP catalog refresh abort when the final standalone App operation waiter detaches, or should it finish to warm the catalog for the next operation?
rationale: The deadline-ordering concern is resolved, while final-waiter cancellation determines shared runtime and cache semantics that tests and contributor proof cannot select without owner intent.

options.title: Allow refresh completion
options.body: Detach cancelled callers but let an already-started catalog refresh finish and populate the cache for later requests.

options.title: Abort with final waiter
options.body: Keep the proposed behavior so abandoned App work terminates connection setup and remaining catalog pagination immediately.

recommendation.title: Allow refresh completion
recommendation.body: Detach cancelled callers but let an already-started catalog refresh finish and populate the cache for later requests.

likelyOwner.reason: A named current-main owner could not be established without the required local feature-history inspection.
